engine: 11tanjung's headline reveal — a multi-line display title MATERIALISES via a per-word gaussian blur(20px -> 0) + opacity(0 -> 1), staggered ~100ms per word, with NO translate (a frosted focus-pull: words sharpen into place where they sit). Distinct from a mask-up/rise reveal — the words don't move, they come INTO FOCUS. Harvested from D_11tanjung (H3; a027 'A New' sharp first -> a033 'of Living' last).

measured_teardown.move: each word starts filter: blur(20px) + opacity 0; on play they animate to blur(0) + opacity 1, staggered by word order, ease-out ~580ms. The cursive headline is a 3-line split layout (line1 left, line2 right, line3 left, diagonal).
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung a027 ('A New' sharpening first, 'Standard' / 'of Living' still blurred) -> a033 (all sharp). No vertical translate on the words.

ease.what: blur falls off quickly then settles.

order.what: optional array of word indices for a non-left-to-right reveal order.

entry: BlurRevealStaggerTitle.create(target, opts) -> { words, play(o), set(p), reset(), destroy }. target = a heading element; its textContent is split into per-word inline-block spans (.brst-word). play() runs the staggered focus-pull; set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of all words (scroll-drivable); reset() back to blurred.
law: filter(blur) + opacity only; per-word GPU layer (will-change); NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> shown sharp. GSAP optional (drives a proxy writing the same filter/opacity); built-in rAF fallback. PERF: blur animates ONLY on reveal (a short burst), not on a continuous scroll surface — so it's safe (unlike blur over a scrubbed/video layer). owns_pin false.
gate_mode: DOM text filter (no , triggered) — the wheel-scroll gate doesn't apply. Verify the per-word stagger + sharpen + smoothness directly.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO render, headline 'Новий стандарт життя' (3-line split layout, Playfair italic) — each word blur 20->0 + opacity 0->1, stagger 0.11s, power2.out. Mid-reveal verified: 'Новий' blur 3.1px/op .84, 'стандарт' 15.3px/.24, 'життя' 20px/0 (focus-pull cascade, matches a028). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 0/268 long frames (0.0%), 59.9fps — blur safe because it's a reveal burst, not a scroll surface.
